spanish: Y macho cabrío de pecado uno, aparte de holocausto del continuo, su minjá y su libación.

findings.issue: מִנְחָה (H4503) is a common noun left as the untranslated lemma minjá; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Remaining tokens match: goat of sin, one, apart from the continual burnt offering, and its libation.
